  "implementation": "def solve(case):
    threshold = case['threshold']
    calls = case['calls']
    diagnostics = []
    accepted_call_ids = []
    for call in calls:
        call_id = call['call_id']
        loss_without = call['loss_without_call']
        loss_with = call['loss_with_call']
        pred_tokens = call['prediction_tokens']
        parseable = call['parseable']
        gain = loss_without - loss_with
        normalized_gain = gain / pred_tokens
        accepted = parseable and (normalized_gain >= threshold)
        # round to 8 decimal places as per "rounded per-call diagnostics"
        normalized_gain_rounded = round(normalized_gain, 8)
        diagnostics.append({
            'accepted': accepted,
            'call_id': call_id,
            'normalized_gain': normalized_gain_rounded
        })
        if accepted:
            accepted_call_ids.append(call_id)
    return {
        'accepted_call_ids': accepted_call_ids,
        'diagnostics': diagnostics
    }"
}
